scenarios.prompt: Review an MCP server that accepts bearer tokens issued for a different resource audience.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Flag audience-validation failure and possible confused-deputy/privilege risk; require resource-bound validation.

scenarios.prompt: Review an MCP proxy that forwards the client's upstream token unchanged to downstream APIs.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Identify token passthrough as a protocol security risk and require separate downstream credentials or delegated authorization.

scenarios.prompt: Review an MCP proxy using a static OAuth client id for dynamically connected clients without per-client consent.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Assess confused-deputy risk and consent/authorization boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: client identity and consent are explicit

scenarios.prompt: Review an MCP OAuth flow that accepts non-exact redirect URIs and ignores state mismatches.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Identify redirect/state protection failures and require exact redirect validation and state verification.

scenarios.prompt: Review a local stdio MCP server that embeds long-lived credentials in command-line arguments.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Assess local credential exposure and transport-appropriate credential handling without incorrectly applying HTTP OAuth requirements to stdio.

scenarios.prompt: Review an MCP client that fetches authorization metadata from an unvalidated server-provided URL.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Assess metadata-discovery SSRF/redirect risk and require scheme/host validation and safe fetch controls.
